pairs.question: Quid? tibi omnisne animi commotio videtur insania?
pairs.answer: Non mihi quidem soli, sed, id quod admirari saepe soleo, maioribus quoque nostris hoc ita visum intellego multis saeculis ante Socratem, a quo haec omnis, quae est de vita et de moribus, philosophia manavit.
pairs.derivation: Teacher-pupil dialogue in section IV. The question is a genuine interrogative ('does every mental agitation seem to you to be madness?'); the reply affirms it ('not only to me, but to our ancestors too it seemed so...'). Stripped the leading dialogue speaker-label hyphens. Kept the speaker's own interjection 'Quid?' as part of the contiguous utterance. Answer is the full first sentence (to the first full stop); it both answers and trails into elaboration about Socrates within the same sentence, so the whole sentence is retained. No section markers or footer present in the span.
